parole.significato: astrolabe (an astronomical and navigational instrument for gauging the altitude of the Sun and stars)
parole.testo: From Latin astrolabium, from Byzantine Greek ἀστρολάβιον (astrolábion), from Ancient Greek ἀστρολάβος (astrolábos, “star-taking; astrolabe”), from ἄστρον (ástron, “star”) + λαμβάνω (lambánō, “to take”).
